watch.en: Set the custard in a water bath.

why.en: The edges then cook at the same pace as the middle, which gives a smooth finish.
why.de: So garen die Ränder im gleichen Tempo wie die Mitte, und die Creme wird glatt.

sources.title: Introduction to Baking and Pastries (Rink and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: The outside edges cook evenly with the middle of the custard.

sources.title: Introduction to Baking and Pastries (Rink and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: Even cooking is need to produce a smooth finish once cooked.
